notes.title: The game was released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the game was released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1507490/Hentai_Killer_Girls__Chess/

We hope you like the game, and even if you don't, please leave your feedback and a review! The reviews are lifeblood for all the games on this platform, and we really need your support!

[h3]Content updates[/h3]
As long as this launch will be not a total disaster, we we will add [b]FREE [/b] levels and gallery update. Expect it in about 2-3 weeks, maybe a tiny bit sooner.

[h3]Trading cards[/h3]
That about trading cards, we already done them, but for approving them and publish we need to complete some conditions. 
So with your help, we can get trading cards, icons, background and emoticons much faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40580605/f03005259a7b4aad4b435ebcf60696c17b0457ea.png[/img]

[b]Thanks all![/b]
